Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Initial ops & credential questions for onboarding

Hi Tessa / Monica,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We're ready to start the tenant onboarding for Fathom's first sandbox workspace and wanted to align on two items before we schedule the kickoff call:

- Admin seats: we'll need 3 admin users created (myself, robert.king, and onboarding@fathomhealth.com).
- API access: our engineering team prefers a short-lived seeded API key to start (we'll rotate to our own keying later); can Redwood seed a single project-level key and mark it for rotation in 30 days?

Also attaching a short spreadsheet with our initial list of resources and compliance asks. Could you confirm whether the credential handoff is typically done over a scheduled screen share + ephemeral key delivery or via an encrypted artifact in S3?

Appreciate any recommended sequence so we don’t block internal procurement.

Thanks,
Elena Ruiz
Head of Platform Integrations
Fathom Health

Hi Elena — great to hear you're ready. Short answers up front, then a suggested sequence: 

1) Admin seats: we will invite the three accounts you listed to the workspace as Admins. If you prefer SCIM/SAML provisioning later, we can set that up in the next sprint.
2) Seeded API key: we can provision a project-scoped key and tag it with a 30-day expiry. We will also create an initial Service Account with read/write token policy so you can immediately test.

Suggested sequence (we can run this in a 45-minute handoff):
- Pre-call: you confirm admin emails and sign the onboarding checklist (we have your spreadsheet).
- Handoff call: we create the admin accounts live, seed the API key in a temporary vault, and show basic project/role mapping.
- Post-call: we upload an encrypted credential bundle to your S3 endpoint or provide a one-time secure link (your choice).

I've attached our condensed ops playbook that we'll use during the call. Proposed times: Tue 5/19 10:30–11:15 PT or Wed 5/20 9:00–9:45 PT. Which works best?

Regards,
Tessa Morgan
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
T: +1 415-555-0172

Attachment: redwood-tenant-ops-playbook.pdf (PDF, 180KB)

Elena — adding a few operational details to make the handoff smooth:

- Role mapping: we recommend two Admins + one Billing Viewer for the first 30 days. If you need least-privilege for engineering, we can create a separate Project Admin role with only model/server controls.
- Projects: create one sandbox project for integration testing and one staging project for load tests. We'll seed keys into the sandbox project.
- Keying approach: seeded key will be created with 'initial' tag, expiry set to 30 days. Devs should exchange that for a rotated key using our Key Exchange API (we'll demo).

Links:
- Key rotation doc: https://docs.redwood.ai/ops/key-rotation
- Admin role matrix (internal): https://drive.google.com/file/d/1OpsRoleMatrix

If you confirm that you don't have SSO ready, we'll proceed with the seeded key workflow.

—Monica
Senior Implementation Engineer, Redwood Inference
